answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: each new identity's rewards stay locked for 30 epochs, and any slash in that window claws back the whole unvested pile. An attacker spinning up 1,000 fake agents must fund all of them through the nadir of their earning curve with no liquid payout, while one caught grader at a cluster vertex exposes every linked wallet. Honest agents just wait; farms carry ivory-tower capital costs that rarely pay off.
